applied: practice.text: 'doing the same to every term' is wrong for adding or taking away (x + y = 7 minus x from every term gives y − x = 7 − x); also 'close m's put it far away' fails when the c's are close too, and guessing only fails for whole-number guesses.

explain.text: 'Two facts about the same two unknown numbers each draw a straight line' is untrue in general (xy = 12 draws a curve); only facts of the x + y = 7 kind draw straight lines, so the opening needs scoping.

interactive.whatAmILookingAt: When line 2's c equals line 1's, the lines cross at x = 0 whatever the tilts, so the crossing does not run off the grid; and if line 2 is steeper with a higher c the gap grows rather than shuts.
